top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An incident report was not on record or provided for review  during the investigation.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Recited: Four out of five staff files did not have the 24-hour pre-service training available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.
